Using new changes to LISP (dealing with purification hackery) that RLB, myself,
and JONL worked out, I built a LOSER >.  It turns out that it shares two more
pages then current MACSYMA, has five fewer impure pages, is 3 pages smaller,
and can actually run ODE2 DEMO to completion (!!).

I am thus installing this LISP this weekend.

--Howard (The large? --RWK)
